requirements.title: VPS readiness validation
requirements.description: Validate SSH connectivity, Ubuntu version, disk/RAM thresholds, outbound network, ports 80/443 availability, and domain DNS pointing to the VPS.

validation.notes: CLI can post a manifest to /api/v1/preflight.

requirements.title: Preflight errors are actionable
requirements.description: Preflight failures emit a specific reason and next-step hint (e.g. DNS not pointing, ports blocked, SSH auth failed) without leaking secrets.
